messages:
Timothy (Tim) Patel: Hello everyone  day 0 here! Joining Platform/SRE from Toronto. Im into houseplants (big fan of sunflowers), biking, and iced coffee. Quick setup questions below.
Jesse (People Ops): Welcome @Timothy!! :tada: Buddy assigned (Rae). HR onboarding threads + MDM invite should be in your inbox. Ping if anything is missing.
Timothy (Tim) Patel: I tried the MDM enrolment and it failed with a popup: "Profile installation failed: Device not supported". Any ideas?
Kai (IT): Hey Tim, Kai from IT here. Can you paste the exact error and run the diagnostic? Command: `/usr/local/bin/mdm-check --verbose` Also try re-enrolling at https://mdm.redwood.corp/enroll.
Timothy (Tim) Patel: mdm-check output: `device_type: macbook_pro_14, os_version: 13.6.4, cert: pending`. Sending full stdout to you in DM.
Kai (IT): Got your DM. Looks like the cert issuance got stuck for that model. I reissued the cert and toggled the device-profile flag. Try the portal again; should install now.
Timothy (Tim) Patel: That fixed it  MDM installed, profile active. Thanks Kai!
Timothy (Tim) Patel: Next: who do I request VPN access and SSH keys for the dev k8s cluster from?
Rae (Platform): Hi Tim! Ill add you to `platform-dev` and create an SSH entry. Send me your public key (or paste it here). VPN docs: https://docs.redwood.dev/internal/vpn. Either use `openvpn --config /etc/openvpn/redwood.ovpn` or the corporate MVPN app.
Timothy (Tim) Patel: Public key sent. Also, what channel for cluster questions and which pager?
Rae (Platform): Use #eng-platform for day-to-day, #eng-oncall for urgent incidents. Ill add you to the weekly onboarding pairing session on Thursday at 10:30 PT  we shadow a small rollback ticket.
Timothy (Tim) Patel: Perfect. One more: laptop sticker preferences? I have a tiny request  sunflower sticker trade available :seedling:.
Jesse (People Ops): Haha we have a sticker cache  Ill include ops stickers + sunflower if stock allows. Also we do a welcome lunch next Friday  optional but encouraged :)
infra-bot: Deploy bot: Note: test-node-7 will be rebooted tomorrow 02:00 UTC for kernel patching. Expected downtime ~5 minutes.
Timothy (Tim) Patel: Noted re: reboot. Thanks infra-bot.
Rae (Platform): Welcome aboard! Ping @Rae to schedule pairing or walkthrough of rollout dashboards. Looking forward to working with you.
Jesse (People Ops): Welcome Tim  excited to have you. If you need any HR paperwork reissued, DM me.
